definitions.explanation: A strength-training exercise in which one hangs from a bar and pulls oneself up until the chin is above the bar. A standard fitness exercise.
The state of being suspended or hanging from something. Used in technical or descriptive contexts.

examples.japanese: {懸垂|けんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{十|じゅっ}⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
{懸垂|けんすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|いっ}{回|かい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。

examples.english: A suspended monorail runs hanging below the track.

notes:
Composed of {懸|けん} (suspend/hang) + {垂|すい} (droop/hang down). The exercise meaning (sense 1) is the most commonly encountered usage in everyday conversation. Can also function as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({懸垂|けんすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {懸垂|けんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do pull-ups
- {懸垂|けんすい}⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧: hanging banner/vertical banner
- {懸垂|けんすい}{式|しき}: suspended type (e.g., monorail)
- {逆|さか}{手|て}{懸垂|けんすい}: chin-up (underhand grip)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- チンニング: chinning — English loanword alternative for pull-ups, used in gyms
- ⟦{鉄棒|てつぼう}→鉄棒：17912_tetsubou⟧: horizontal bar — the equipment used for pull-ups (also a gymnastics apparatus)
